title: Enugu — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Enugu: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Enugu has a population of 1,029,000. The capital of Enugu State and a major coal mining city, known as the ‘Coal City’ of Nigeria. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 91 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
